            Roles & responsibilities · rules version 5

            Who does what, now and when Vicinity goes live.

            Leadership is earned over time and chosen by locals, not bought in a minute. Holdings count, but only up to 2× the founder amount, so the biggest wallet can't simply take over. Read every rule →

            🏅

            Holder

            Holds any $VICINITY · vote ×1

            Now

            • Verify your wallet and set your home community.
            • Post memes, check-ins and discussions in your city and country.
            • Report spam and scams: 5 reports hide a post until a moderator reviews it.

            When Vicinity goes live

            • Only holders can post and vote.
            • Endorse who should found your city, and elect your Country Manager: one person, one vote.
            • Founding Supporters are the holders by 14-day average balance at the snapshot: early access to city coins.
            👑

            City Founder

            Chosen by the city · vote ×2

            Now

            • Set your home community (it must be set 7 days before you apply).
            • Bring your locals in: they'll endorse the founder.
            • Plan to hold the founder amount for 7 days straight after launch: balances are checked at random times.

            When Vicinity goes live

            • Apply from inside the city. The first qualified claimer becomes Seed Steward at once: a 90-day probation, confirmed early by 50 verified local holders, and locals can challenge (10 endorsements force an election).
            • If several claim together, a 72-hour window scores them: 50% local endorsements, 30% contribution, 20% holdings (capped at 2×). Then 48 hours for objections.
            • Your bar is set by city size (100K to 1M $VICINITY). Friends can found together: 3 to 5 verified locals can pool as a squad.
            • Moderate the city's feed (hides need a second person). Drop below the amount and moderation pauses; 7 days to fix it (48 hours for a Seed Steward) or the seat reopens.
            • Design the city's coin: name, logo, colour, a short pitch, and what it's paired with (SOL, USDC or RAY). Public, logged, and locked once it launches.
            • At the Launchpad: first right to launch the city's one official coin.
            🛡️

            Country Manager

            Elected for 90 days · vote ×3

            Now

            • The seat opens once the country has founders with 30+ days of service. Until then the Admin covers it.

            When Vicinity goes live

            • Elected by the country's verified locals: 50% votes, 30% service, 20% holdings (capped). 90-day terms, at most two in a row.
            • Hide posts in the country, propose bans (another person must approve), advise on "add my town" requests.
            • Powers pause the moment their founder seat is in grace.
            ⚙️

            Admin

            The Vicinity team · team wallets are public

            Now

            • Decides "add my town" requests, objections to founders and appeals they weren't part of.
            • Moderates everywhere, under the same two-person rules.
            • Publishes team wallets, the snapshot time and every rule change first.

            When Vicinity goes live

            • Publishes the only official contract address.
            • Can never move anyone's tokens, mint, change a launched city's coin, or change rules silently.
            Vicinity
